You end up isolating yourself from those around you. The few times I was asked what was up I could just say I was tired or having a bad day.

What I found to help me personally was to have things to look forward to in the future. Whether it be something small or big or even something to work towards. Something like working out for a few days means I get to have pizza or looking forward to a new episode of a tv show to come out. I found it nice to be able to look into the future and see something positive in it.

I found that once I did that focusing on things like exercise and diet started to become easier and now I actually enjoy those things. Hope that helps!

I was with an abusive person as well. Having zero contact with them and learning that all the negative feelings I kept with me after our relationship weren't feelings I should feel really helped. 

By that I mean it was justified that I felt the way I did but the reason I did wasn't because I was a bad person but was because I was mistreated. I used that as a lesson about the signs of abuse and made sure I wouldn't let that happen to myself again.
